business_problem: Locket needed to add safe, high-speed creative photo features for millions of users without slowing a lean team or compromising the authentic social experience the product was built around.
solution_summary: Locket Labs uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: Locket needed to add safe, high-speed creative photo features for millions of users without slowing a lean team or compromising the authentic social experience the product was built around. Firestore handles instant account management for Locket’s millions of users, serving as the storage layer. Google Cloud Storage stores the huge volume of photo uploads and image assets generated through the app, serving as the storage layer. Bigtable processes heavy database workloads that support the high-volume social product, serving as the storage layer. BigQuery delivers fast behavioral insights that help the small team evaluate feature performance, serving as the storage layer. Gemini powers both creative image capabilities and automated safety checks for explicit content, bullying, and self-harm signals, serving as the compute layer.
